heroHeadline: Peña Nieto: Structural Reforms, Ayotzinapa, and the Collapse of PRI Hegemony
heroSubtitle: Six years of sweeping reforms undercut by Ayotzinapa impunity, Casa Blanca corruption, record homicides, and the gasolinazo — the legal reckoning grows fraught in July 2026 as the CNDH clears the Army in Ayotzinapa even as Encinas reveals a military infiltrator among the 43, the SCJN reopens the 2018 truth-commission sentence, and Lozoya's sister is detained in the Agronitrogenados case
footerNote: Data sourced from Diario Oficial, INEGI, CONEVAL, GIEI/IACHR, Proceso, Animal Político, Aristegui Noticias, MCCI, World Bank, Banxico, Transparency International
